title: Geo-sovereignty evidence assembler for dedicated pools
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build a scheduled evidence assembly pipeline that synthesizes immutable artifacts proving geographic placement and isolation of tenant workloads running on Dedicated capacity. The pipeline will collect node-to-region mappings, disk snapshot manifests, network ACLs and VPC configuration, tenant routing records, KMS key identifiers used for tenant volumes, and retention policy enforcement logs. Output artifacts will be versioned, cryptographically signed, and exported to a compliance bucket and the Console's audit timeline for easy reviewer consumption. This is intended to replace manual evidence collection for audits and to provide continuous attestations for customers who require proof of geographic sovereignty and tenant isolation.
acceptance_criteria: Scheduled job runs daily without human intervention and completes within 30 minutes for a 100-tenant dedicated pool
Assembled report includes node id -> cloud-region mapping, host fingerprints (AMI/image hash), storage encryption KMS ID, active ACL/SG snapshot, and a compact event timeline for the reporting window
Each report file is cryptographically signed by a dedicated signing key and includes a verification manifest accessible from Console
Reports are stored in an immutable compliance S3 bucket with lifecycle rules matching customer retention settings
Console shows per-tenant recent evidence entries and links to the exported artifact and verification status
End-to-end automated tests validate one sample tenant per pool and assert presence of required fields
implementation_notes: Collector agents will run as a cluster task on control-plane nodes with least privilege IAM roles to read metadata and KMS IDs
Use existing residency-mapper service to resolve node->region; extend to include host image hashes and kernel UUIDs
Signatures will use a rotation-capable signing key stored in HSM/KMS; initial prototype uses a signing key material in dev KMS
To minimize impact we will perform heavy collection from read replicas and snapshots rather than live disk mounts
Granularity trade-off: hourly vs daily — start with daily reporting and add higher-frequency endpoints if customers require realtime proofs
Privacy constraint: redact tenant PII from exported manifests; include only tenant identifiers and resource ids necessary for verification

testing_plan: Unit tests for collector transformations and redaction rules
Integration tests that run collector against a synthetic dedicated pool in staging and validate artifact schema
Property-based tests for signature generation and verification with rotated keys
Load test with 500-tenants equivalent to validate job completion SLA

Beta: enable opt-in for select customers with non-production workloads; gather compliance reviewer feedback
GA: enable by default for new dedicated pools and provide migration/runbook for existing customers
Provide an override and on-demand report trigger in Console for auditors
